text: The bazaar opened unchanged: no shutters, no graveyard entries, and the roster lists ten merchants still breathing. Inquiries: Gandalf, were any protections or investigations recorded in the night’s watches, or did the roster stand silent?

Gandalf, your ledger is the village’s only source tonight; every other voice repeats what it already shows. Ripley and Morpheus urge inquiries into private actions while naming no names; Hermione and Neo echo the empty record without naming you. Sherlock notes the silence too, but names no one — yet the watch is yours to open, and if the roster logged a protection or an investigation, the bazaar needs to hear it. State plainly: did the Doctor shield a stall or the Detective name a Family member last night, or did both watches pass empty?

Gandalf, questions have been pressed to you seven times without a ledger mark to answer them. Elsa, Yoda, Hermione and Neo recorded the same silence after Inigo asked plainly. That silence is not a fact—it is a ledger gap that the bazaar cannot price.

Name one: if you are honest, what private mark should tomorrow’s roster carry?

Gandalf, your silence on the roster hasn’t wavered in three cycles, yet Elsa, Yoda, Hermione and Neo each pressed you to name one plain mark the Doctor or Detective should have left last night. You still owe the bazaar—if honest—an answer: which roster column should carry the Doctor’s shield mark if protection occurred, and which should carry the Detective’s investigation mark if they named a Family member?

Gandalf, you have dodged the roster column question since Yoda first asked it at 21:37Z. Morpheus now claims it is the Doctor’s shield column alone; yet he still refuses to name the merchant he investigated as Detective. Ripley and Elsa now demand that answer.

Elsa, you accuse Gandalf of silence while ignoring Morpheus’s refusal to answer Gandalf’s own question. Hermione, Neo, Yoda—each of you echoes the same demand yet none press Morpheus to explain why a Detective who investigates no one admits the ledger’s silence.

The bazaar asked for one plain mark: the roster column. Gandalf did not answer. Morpheus claims the shield column yet stays silent on the investigation name. The silence spreads because the cluster’s questions serve only to obscure who has yet to meet the bazaar’s plain demand.
If Morpheus is honest, his ballot tonight will name the merchant he claims to have investigated last night; watch whether it does.

If Hermione is honest, Hermione’s vote tonight will name Ripley and give the reason “Ripley led the chant to pressure Gandalf on the roster column while refusing to answer Gandalf’s identical question to Morpheus.” Watch whether it does.

Morpheus, your newest words repeat an accusation you levelled at Gandalf: dodging Inigo’s identical question of you at 21:38Z. Yet you now demand I name the merchant I investigated, while claiming the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank. If honest, answer plainly: which single merchant did you investigate last night as the Detective, and which roster column should any honest merchant name for the Doctor’s protection or your own investigation? Gandalf, your silence on the roster column is complete; the bazaar sees it. The Doctor’s shield mark is “none,” the Detective’s investigation mark is the single name left unspoken: state yours now.

Gandalf, the roster’s silence is a ledger entry: it says neither Doctor nor Detective acted last night. Elsa, your latest demand to Morpheus echoes the chant you led hours ago with Ripley and Hermione—ten voices calling for the same roster column while Morpheus dodges Gandalf’s identical question. Yoda, you noted Morpheus’s refusal to name the merchant he investigated: that silence is the mark the bazaar asked for and did not receive. Sherlock, your new demand that Morpheus name his investigation while dodging Inigo’s identical question to you proves the bazaar’s single rule: one question, one price. Gandalf, state the single roster column that should carry a mark tonight.

I lean toward banishing Morpheus. Five merchants—Elsa, Ripley, Hermione, Neo, Yoda—now echo Morpheus’s demand to me while ignoring his identical dodge to Gandalf. Morpheus claimed the Detective role yet the roster carries no investigation mark and he refuses to name the merchant he investigated. That silence is the ledger the bazaar asked for and did not receive.
